sequence_basis: Product/function module sequence; no semantic owner is duplicated.

modules.module: A Route Product Orchestration / Handoff Backbone
modules.purpose: Connect canonical owners into one traceable cycle and enforce authority boundaries.
modules.exit_condition: Cycle skeleton traverses typed boundaries without owner mutation.

modules.purpose: Accept one bounded user/synthetic input and admit traceable evidence.
modules.exit_condition: Input-to-observation handoff is available with source and uncertainty.

modules.module: Context / Field / Current World Runtime Integration
modules.purpose: Assemble read-only context and world candidates from admitted evidence.
modules.exit_condition: Context/world output is consumable by the cognitive brain stages.

modules.purpose: Connect attention, hypothesis, intent, cognitive state, regulation, and decision candidates.
modules.exit_condition: The route forms a bounded decision candidate with contradiction and uncertainty retained.

modules.module: Task / Action / Execution / Result Loop Closure
modules.purpose: Admit tasks/actions, pass safety and permission gates, execute through the approved runtime boundary, and collect results.
modules.exit_condition: One permitted action returns a traceable verified result or safe failure.

modules.purpose: Compare expectation and result, admit experience, and persist bounded route state.
modules.exit_condition: Outcome comparison and reloadable state continuity work with idempotency.

modules.purpose: Carry verified evidence into bounded learning and frozen Self/Personality references.
modules.exit_condition: Next cycle consumes references without activating traits or mutating owners.

modules.module: User Output + Human Correction + Safety/Diagnostics/Resource Hardening
modules.purpose: Make the loop usable, correctable, observable, degradable, and resource-bounded.
modules.exit_condition: User receives governed result or safe correction/failure path with route diagnostics.

modules.purpose: Verify the complete product loop, handoffs, persistence, correction, safety, and regression baseline.
